connector.name: срезAI - Search API for AI agents
connector.registryDescription: Web search, page reading and structured extraction for AI agents, with strong RU coverage
connector.summary: Hosted at srezai.ru over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ru.srezai, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: API key in the form: Bearer srz_live_YOUR_KEY. Create one in the dashboard at https://srezai.ru/dashboard.
